name: Clock: withdraw
description: The backstop clock, and the season's. Seasons overlap (N30), so every statement here is per season and set-based: a tick may close, sweep or snapshot more than one live season of the game at once. Three idempotent statements a minute, none fenced. The sweep cancels every queued match whose season has closed, whose engine has been retired or whose seats have stopped contesting, recording why and, where there is one, the successor that replaced the seat -- each match by its own season. The close ends EACH live season the admin has asked to close or whose window has closed and every score has settled -- no submission undecided, nothing in flight, every active version at or below settled_sigma with at least burst matches -- and freezes each one's podium into season_podium in the same statement. rows_affected is zero almost every minute in each, which is not a halt. Promotion does its own withdraw and the close cancels its own queue, so a persistently non-zero sweep count is a signal, not routine. The snapshot writes every live season's ladder_snapshots once an hour, which the rating series reads. A close that wrote is followed by one notification per entrant of each season that just closed, keyed on the season, and a medal per placed owner, each in a task that may fail without failing the close (the notifiers read every season closed in the last few minutes, which is every season this tick closed).

tasks.name: Cancel what can no longer be played

tasks.description: Versions withdrawn: the ladder and season documents move, and count has verdicts to read (`gen:finished`).

tasks.name: Close the season if it has settled or was asked to
Tell people the season closed
tasks.description: Only after a close that wrote. Each notifier is its own statement after the decision and may fail without failing the close or the other.

tasks.name: Tell everyone who entered that the season closed
Tell each placed owner their medal
tasks.description: One row per podium place the close froze, to its owner, category `season`. A task of its own after the decision, like notify_closed, so a failure here never undoes a close.

tasks.name: Snapshot the ladders on the hour
tasks.description: Every ladder of the live season as ladder_at() reads it at the top of the hour, once an hour: the rating series and a model's rank a week ago read these rows instead of the whole event history. Idempotent, and last, so a failure here never skips the close or its notifications.
